verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for calendar products, since self-hostable alternatives exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Google Calendar can be self-hosted. The docs describe a Google-hosted REST API, and the one self-hosting mention is a user who left for Radicale, which is a workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
